news.title: Star freshman showed up late to county final, then scored game-winner to lead N.J. soccer program to 1st title
news.excerpt: Freshman Mahlia Drummond scored the only goal as sixth-seeded Newark Academy beat top-seeded, undefeated Livingston 1-0 for the program's first Essex County Tournament girls soccer title.

news.title: Newark Academy Makes History
news.excerpt: After upsets of Verona and MKA, the Minutemen won their first-ever ECT final 1-0 over No. 7 Livingston on Oct. 28 at Bonnel Field, with sophomore keeper Leila Chatterjee making 12 saves.

news.title: Junior’s lone goal powers Cranford girls soccer past Nutley in N2G3 quarterfinals
news.excerpt: Cranford advances to the semifinals on Tuesday.

news.title: Championship 3-peat within reach: Aggression outweighs heavy rain in semis for G1 favorites
news.excerpt: Cedar Grove scored 48 first-half points to win Friday night's semifinals matchup at home.

news.title: Coach records milestone win as No. 17 Livingston girls soccer advances to N1G4 semis
news.excerpt: Livingston advances to the semifinals on Tuesday.

news.title: Scotch Plains-Fanwood boys soccer stifles Irvington in N2G4 Quarterfinal
news.excerpt: After narrowly escaping a massive upset in the first round, Scotch Plains-Fanwood put together a performance more in line with that of a second-seeded team to down Irvington

news.title: Two 1st-half goals lead Newark Academy girls soccer over Oak Knoll in NJNPA quarterfinals
news.excerpt: Newark Academy (16-3-2), which has won nine of their last 10 games, advanced to the semifinals and will host third-seeded Pingry on Monday, Nov. 9.
